_comment: Delivering the dead god's letter to the Anchorite. The second god-questline opener.
THE LOCKED SOURCE IS THE LETTER ITSELF, which shipped before this scene existed:
SUBJECT: MASS AUTHORITY -- no matter arising
'There is no matter arising. I have checked the register twice and there is nothing
I am required to raise with you, which is why this has taken the form it has. The
undersigned has no procedure for the other kind.'
'You held the corner of it while I set the rest. I do not think either of us has
said so since. Filed for the record, in case there is one.'
So the relationship is not an estrangement at all -- it is a shared piece of WORK,
long ago, that neither of them ever acknowledged. The dead god wanted to say thank
you and could only do it by filing a form that exists for saying nothing.
THE ANCHORITE IS THE OPPOSITE OF THE VERDANT AND THAT IS THE DESIGN. The Verdant
opens mid-argument, defending an arrangement nobody mentioned. This one does not
defend anything, because it has not been thinking about the falling-out at all. It
has been holding something. It asks what the load is before it asks who you are,
because that is the only question it has.
WHAT IT HAS BEEN HOLDING, and this is the scene: 'you held the corner of it while I
set the rest.' Nobody ever came back and said the setting was finished. So it did not
let go. Its whole world is a place where unanchored things rise and do not stop --
already built, already the law the ferry's boarding notice promises -- and the reason
is that the only thing it is still holding down is that one corner.
The UNANIMOUS node is telling it the setter is dead and it can put the corner down.
That is a mercy and it is also the end of the only job it has had for an age, which is
why nobody gets to do it alone. Same reasoning as the shrine-keeper's one cruelty and
the Verdant's.
THE NAME IS NOT IN THIS FILE. `tools/letters_check.py` asserts categorically that the
three names appear in their own letters and nowhere else in the shipped string table.
A delivery scene is the most tempting place in the mod to break that. The Anchorite
notices the salutation without repeating it, which is the stronger beat regardless.
Dread covenant: the grief is sincere and is never the punchline. What is allowed to be
funny is the SYSTEM -- a register checked twice, a form that exists for reporting the
absence of business, an authority with no procedure for gratitude. Nobody winks.
Regard: ANCHORITE throughout. As with the Verdant there is no path that makes it
comfortable, and for the same reason: a deicide locks every surviving god at a
permanent ceiling. The most generous route here is worth +30 against a floor of -45.
